rules.statement: Where a will is found destroyed or mutilated, in a place in which the testator would have naturally put it, the presumption is that the testator destroyed it, and that the destruction was done animo revocandi.
rules.supporting_quote: Where a will is found destroyed or mutilated, in a place in which the testator would have naturally put it, the presumption is that the testator destroyed it, and that the destruction was done animo revocandi...... but this presumption is only prima facie and may be rebutted
